result.description:
About Us

Driven by our “Safety | Service | Production” principles and over 17 years of operations excellence. Core Drilling Services has positioned itself as a leading boutique full-service provider that is agile and adaptive to the various requirements of our clients.

We specialize in innovative semi-autonomous and conventional drill rig packages, offering expert technical services in reverse circulation, diamond, geological and geotechnical sampling services Australia-wide.

About the Role

The Driller plays a key role in overseeing and operating drilling equipment, ensuring safety, efficiency, and productivity while managing the crew, maintaining equipment, and adhering to safety and environmental regulations.

Some of the responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Lead drill rig and site moves, ensuring optimal positioning for efficiency and safety.
* Operate and maintain drill rig systems and equipment efficiently.
* Set up and dismantle drilling equipment and machinery, ensuring readiness for operation.
* Perform routine and scheduled maintenance to minimize downtime, including greasing, checking fluid levels, and cleaning the rig.
* Report any mechanical defects or anomalies to the Drill Rig Supervisor.
* Take responsibility for the health, safety, and performance of the drill crew.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations, including correct PPE use and maintaining a clean, safe work environment.
* Identify and address hazards or risks during daily operations.
* Refuel and restock the drill rig for the next crew at handover.
* Schedule and complete maintenance in line with the drilling cycle or shift change to maximize efficiency.
* Monitor drilling parameters (pressure, depth, weight, etc.) to ensure smooth operation.
* Record operational data, including drilling depth, rate of penetration, and any anomalies.
* Complete and submit consumable orders each weekend before COB Sunday.
* Accurately complete and submit all required documentation, including daily PLODs.
* Manage the drill rig budget effectively.
* Identify and report initiatives to improve safety, productivity, and efficiency.
* Maintain and update all compliance registers for the drill rig.
* Support the development and implementation of organizational procedures and processes.
* Maintain a high standard of housekeeping around the drill pad and work areas at all times.
* Maintain focus on time utilization and operational efficiency.
* Mentor and guide drill crew members to ensure safe and efficient operations.

Qualifications and Criteria

* Relevant trade qualifications (Certificate III or IV in Drilling Operations) – desirable
* Minimum of 2 years relevant experience working in a similar role - preferred
* Valid Manual Driver’s Licence (HR class)
* National Police Check (issued within the last 12 months)
* Current CPR Certificate (issued within the last 12 months)
* Current First Aid Certificate (issued within the last 2 years)
* 4WD Group 1 Certificate (issued within the last 2 years)
* Fire Extinguisher Training Certificate (issued within the last 2 years) – preferred
* Working Safely at Heights Certificate (issued within the last 2 years) – preferred
* Strong mechanical aptitude
* Proven ability to follow instructions and adhere to safety procedures
* Demonstrated strong work ethic and ability to work effectively in a team
* Good problem-solving skills
* Effective verbal and written communication skills

Salary range: $90,000 – $130,000 per annum (depending on experience and qualifications)

At Core Drilling Services, you’ll be part of a company that values teamwork, innovation, and personal growth. We offer long-term opportunities for professional development, a supportive team culture, and the chance to work with advanced drilling technology.

Resource Corner Pty Ltd has been built on the principles of integrity, partnership and innovation, traits that have allowed Resource Corner to establish itself as leader in its field since 2006. Resource Corner is global technology enterprise, focused on delivering excellence in complex digital environment, with relentless dedication in IT consulting and services. Resource Corner IT has been working with Banking and Telecom and Federal Department to help them achieve business agility, competitive edge, and growth.

Position Summary:
We are seeking a passionate and detail-oriented Software Tester to join our team in Australia.
Job location:
Head Office is in Norwest Business Park, Norwest NSW 2153, you will be required to work on clients' office (on multiple locations possible), depending on the engagement, whilst remaining a direct employee of Resource Corner

Type of position:
Permanent Ongoing

Minimum Qualification:
Any bachelor’s degree in major computing or equivalent

Experience Range: 5 to 15 years.

Job Description – Software Tester

Responsibilities:

• Researching, consulting, analyzing and evaluating system program needs.
• Identifying technology limitations and deficiencies in existing systems and associated processes, procedures and methods.
• Testing, debugging, diagnosing and correcting errors and faults in an applications programming language within established testing protocols, guidelines and quality standards to ensure programs and applications perform to specification.
• Writing and maintaining program code to meet system requirements, system designs and technical specifications in accordance with quality accredited standards.
• Writing, updating and maintaining technical program, end user documentation and operational procedures.
• Providing advice, guidance and expertise in developing proposals and strategies for software design activities such as financial evaluation and costing for recommending software purchases and upgrades.

Skills Required:

• Relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent experience in IT highly regarded.
• Business orientation with strong IT background.
• 5+ years’ experience in software testing in banking, cards, payments, insurance or financial services environment is desirable.
• Experience in automation testing using selenium, java, tosca, cucumber, cypress or any other automation tool.
• Experience on manual, functional and regression testing is good to have.
• Payments experience with testing on cards, POS & terminal testing is a plus.
• Testing APIs using REST, SOAP UI, Postman etc.
• Experience on ETL, Data warehouse, Big Data testing is advantageous.
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills at all levels.


Salary Range: $100k to $150k plus super

Next steps
If you feel this opportunity suits you, or RESOURCE CORNER IT is the type of organization you would like to join, we want to have a conversation with you! Please apply directly with us.

If you have a passion for leveraging the best from cutting-edge technologies; have an eye for elegance, flexibility and efficiency in design; and are passionate about technology we want to hear from you.
